Resolves #19482

The 13.2 notes' iteration 6 sweeps `cec2fcce84..d75cc68543`: 23 first-parent merges after #19432. It also replaces a sentence that #19471 made stale and moves the claim-reply bound.

**Dispositions (23):**
- **Lines (12).**
  - Dock: #19449 warns a tear-out host that publishes no sort group, at projection. #19458 closes the parked-vessel re-show plane the chapter had left open. #19443 makes the tour enter through Reset. #19464 makes a legacy dashboard popup return its widget once.
  - Runtime: #19468 and #19479 share a new paragraph in *A render belongs to its own flight*.
  - Components: #19463 keeps the header's scroll extent through a column drag, and #19466 leaves the body of a header-handled item to the page.
  - Package: #19435 resolves relative connection URLs from the page, with an upgrade row. #19471 makes the consumer check prove the source-only package.
  - Explore: #19434 (DevIndex's dist tabs) and #19447 (the DateSelector, @sloemo01).
- **Full Changelog (7).** The Demo B tour's cue alignment #19469; the test-only witnesses #19473, #19460 and #19445; the agent-substrate changes #19457, #19453 and #19439.
- **Dependency bumps (4),** Full Changelog: #19476, #19475, #19474, #19441.

**Stale claim replaced:** the package chapter said the consumer check "builds the browser bundles before it packs". Since #19471 it packs the source, installs it into a fixture workspace, runs `npm run bundle-browser-deps` inside the installed package, and requires the bundle files the runtime addresses (`buildScripts/util/check-consumer-runtime-build.mjs`, `main`).

**Claim-reply bound:** 75 `claim-responder.yml` runs since #19414 merged (2026-10-06 11:08Z), all skipped, through 2026-10-09 05:26Z.

The banner reads iteration 6. The #14800 cut list's sweep point moves to `d75cc68543`.

Evidence: L1 (a documentation sweep; every new claim was written from its PR's body, links that PR, and was checked merged through the API) → L1 required. Residual: none; merges after `d75cc68543` belong to the cut.
